addons.name: release-policy-v17
addons.reason: Adapt the previously reviewed fork Python certification tooling and examples to released upstream v0.17.0.

addons.name: prime-native-v17
addons.reason: Port the existing Prime native addon onto the released v0.17.0 source and retain its verification entry points.

addons.name: skill-command-recovery-v17
addons.reason: Port durable skill invocation claims, unknown admission recovery, REQUEST reevaluation and saved-history replay guards; retain v0.17 route semantics.

addons.name: prime-verification-map
addons.reason: Document Prime as the thirteenth native provider and link the maintained CLI, terminal and HTTP verification entry points.

addons.name: prime-preflight-types-and-comment-audit
addons.reason: Apply the addon comment audit and repair the Prime preflight test collaborators with the actual typed client and process-manager interfaces.

addons.name: fork-installation-guide
addons.reason: Direct fork users to verified released assets and the maintained installation and upgrade instructions.

addons.name: skill-recovery-documentation-repair
addons.reason: Include the history-resume replay regression suite in the documented command-recovery checks; close independent review finding DOC-001.

addons.name: fork-version-v17
addons.reason: Stamp all four packages, runtime version and sibling lock records as 0.17.0+mdsmithaustin.1; preserve all upstream third-party records.

addons.name: native-ownership-filelock-floor
addons.reason: Require the frozen and tested filelock 3.29.1 API for asynchronous native ownership locking without changing resolved third-party artifacts.

addons.name: native-source-stop-authority
addons.reason: Persist the typed source owner, admission epoch and exact Stop outcome; check qualified closure in the destination insertion transaction.

addons.name: native-source-stop-runtime
addons.reason: Fence native creation and deferred input with their original source admission, serialize Prime requests and physical close, expose honest owner Stop outcomes and reader fork behavior.

addons.name: native-stop-schema-and-comment-audit
addons.reason: Regenerate the published Stop result schema, remove seven scoped prose units, and name the existing wrapper lock ownership predicate without changing the lock protocol.

addons.name: initial-release-pin
addons.reason: Record the first twelve ordered addon commits. Later repairs reopen the inventory.

addons.name: prime-and-switch-workflow-documentation
addons.reason: Preserve the upstream switch-agent HTTP 410 contract and remove a link to an absent lifecycle verifier.

addons.name: authenticated-native-owner-admission
addons.reason: Require the current runner proof before recording or validating an owner on authenticated servers. Preserve existing local single-user trust.

addons.name: original-skill-admission-and-legacy-stop
addons.reason: Carry admission captured before skill resolution to dispatch. Reject revoked or missing owner admission durably, and attempt legacy shutdown without reporting verified closure.

addons.name: native-skill-readiness-regressions
addons.reason: Exercise the native writer boundary and document that missing owner admission requires startup or resume followed by a new invocation.

addons.name: required-codex-parity-certification
addons.reason: Build and run canonical Codex parity inside the certificate workflow and reject empty, all-skipped, failed, or errored results.

addons.name: reviewed-release-pin
addons.reason: Record the eighteen-commit source pin and decision trail before CI. Subsequent CI repairs reopen the inventory.

addons.name: native-stop-error-fence-repair
addons.reason: Clear the output fence when legacy Stop fails, preserve the runner error, and assert REQUEST denial when plaintext does not prove invocation identity.

addons.name: snapshot-native-source-fixture
addons.reason: Supply the existing native source lookup in the snapshot store fake without changing response assertions.

addons.name: runner-native-admission-fixtures
addons.reason: Supply typed native admission collaborators and fresh Prime heartbeat setup while preserving runner behavior assertions.

addons.name: prime-and-model-source-fixtures
addons.reason: Provide real admission configuration for Prime wrapper tests and control ambient provider metadata in model catalog fixtures.

addons.name: runner-launch-admission-fixtures
addons.reason: Initialize existing typed admission clients in launch, recovery, and inbox test fixtures while preserving all behavioral assertions.

addons.name: runner-control-contract-fixtures
addons.reason: Exercise actual native readiness and control signatures, assert rejected native transfer with unchanged ownership, and retain exact model source metadata.

addons.name: resource-native-proof-fixture
addons.reason: Supply absent-native-source proof invalidation in the resource route store fake without changing runtime behavior.

addons.name: fork-explicit-stop-fixtures
addons.reason: Admit source ownership and perform public Stop with exact mock receipts before downstream alias and upload fork assertions. This does not qualify real non-Prime shutdown.

addons.name: codex-launch-admission-fixtures
addons.reason: Supply the existing typed source admission server to Codex startup tests so catalog, policy, MCP, and cancellation cleanup assertions execute.
